title: The Midnight Library
author: Matt Haig
shortDescription: A novel about a woman who finds herself in a library between life and death, where each book shows a different version of her life.

title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
shortDescription: An astronaut wakes up on a spaceship with no memory of his mission and must save Earth from an extinction-level threat.

title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
shortDescription: A reclusive Hollywood icon recounts her rise to fame and the seven husbands who shaped her life.

title: Klara and the Sun
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
shortDescription: An Artificial Friend with exceptional observational qualities watches customers who come and go in a store.

title: The Invisible Life of Addie LaRue
author: V.E. Schwab
shortDescription: A young woman makes a Faustian bargain to live forever but is cursed to be forgotten by everyone she meets.

title: Where the Crawdads Sing
author: Delia Owens
shortDescription: A young woman who raised herself in the marshes of North Carolina becomes a suspect in a murder investigation.

title: The Song of Achilles
author: Madeline Miller
shortDescription: A retelling of the Iliad from the perspective of Patroclus, focusing on his relationship with Achilles.

title: The Vanishing Half
author: Brit Bennett
shortDescription: The story of twin sisters who choose to live in two very different worlds, one black and one white.
